data.title: Remote Access Polish
data.body: The register command + API for DNS/certs exists but is undocumented. This is the killer feature—accessing dev server from phone/another machine. Need full documentation and a streamlined CLI command that does the whole flow in one step.

data.title: Framework Detection Gaps
data.body: Expand auto-detection to cover more modern frameworks. Currently missing popular stacks that users expect to just work.

data.title: First-Run Experience
data.body: New user path is unclear. After npx jump.sh install, there is no interactive guidance. Need a welcoming flow that gets users to wow quickly.

data.title: Health & Notifications
data.body: Container crashes are silent. Users only know when they try to open the URL and it fails. Need proactive notification when things go wrong.

data.title: Document remote access setup flow
data.body: Write comprehensive docs for the full remote setup: DNS registration, cert provisioning, firewall/port considerations. Add to README and/or separate docs page.

data.title: Add jump.sh share command
data.body: Single command that does: register machine, download certs, configure DNS, print shareable URL. Should be the one-step path to remote access.

data.title: Add SvelteKit detection
data.body: Detect SvelteKit projects (svelte.config.js, @sveltejs/kit in package.json). Generate appropriate docker-compose with vite dev server. Relates to existing issue #3.

data.title: Add Astro detection
data.body: Detect Astro projects (astro.config.mjs, astro in package.json). Generate appropriate docker-compose.

data.title: Add Remix detection
data.body: Detect Remix projects (@remix-run/node or @remix-run/react in package.json). Generate appropriate docker-compose.

data.title: Add Bun runtime detection
data.body: Detect Bun projects (bun.lockb, bunfig.toml). Use bun runtime instead of node in docker-compose.

data.title: Add jump.sh init command
data.body: Interactive first-run wizard: detect projects in cwd or common locations, prompt to add first project, show next steps. Gets new users to working state quickly.

data.title: Show QR code for mobile access
data.body: After remote access is configured, show QR code in dashboard that phones can scan to open the project URL. Requires remote access working first.

data.title: Desktop notifications on container crash
data.body: Integrate with system notification APIs (node-notifier or similar). Send notification when a container exits unexpectedly or health check fails.

data.title: Add container health check polling
data.body: Periodically verify running containers are actually healthy (not just running). Surface unhealthy state in dashboard before full crash.

Write comprehensive docs for the full remote setup.

## Done when
- README has Remote Access section with step-by-step instructions
- Covers: DNS registration, cert provisioning, firewall/port requirements
- Includes troubleshooting for common failures (port blocked, cert expired)
- A new user can follow docs and access their dev server from phone

Single command that handles the entire remote access flow.

## Done when
- `jump.sh share` exists and works end-to-end
- Registers machine with API if not already registered
- Downloads/refreshes certs automatically
- Configures DNS routing
- Prints shareable URL at the end
- Works on fresh install (no prior setup required)
- Errors are actionable (tells user what to fix)

Interactive first-run wizard for new users.

## Done when
- `jump.sh init` command exists
- Scans cwd and common locations (~/code, ~/projects, ~/dev) for projects
- Prompts user to select which project(s) to add
- Offers to start the first project immediately
- Shows next steps (dashboard URL, how to add more)
- Works well in non-interactive mode (--yes flag)

Show QR code in dashboard for easy mobile access.

## Done when
- Dashboard shows QR code for each running project (when remote access configured)
- QR encodes the full https URL
- QR is scannable by standard phone camera apps
- Only shows when project is actually accessible remotely
- Does not show in dev mode or when remote not configured

Send desktop notification when containers crash.

## Done when
- Uses node-notifier or native APIs for cross-platform notifications
- Notification fires when container exits with non-zero code
- Notification fires when health check fails 3x consecutively
- Notification includes project name and actionable info
- Can be disabled via config (JUMPSH_NOTIFICATIONS=false)
- Works on macOS and Linux

Periodically verify container health, surface issues before full crash.

## Done when
- DockerManager polls running containers every 30s (configurable)
- HTTP health check to container port (or docker health if configured)
- Dashboard shows degraded state for unhealthy containers
- Unhealthy state triggers notification system (if enabled)
- Health status available via `jump.sh status` CLI
